Each of the three hypersurface branches is normal, and its pairwise intersection with another branch is the reduced smooth Cartier curve; this forces each branch regular and pairwise transverse. The explicit coordinate changes take the third equation a x+b y to X-Y, yielding XY(X-Y), and the normalization is consequently smooth minimal elliptic ruled. Two outside components cannot be adjacent: the positive full-fibre multiplicity relations would give both m_E>m_Eprime and m_Eprime>m_E. Therefore all such components are pairwise disjoint leaves.
